fullPassage:
Dear Mr. Johnson,

Have you "settled into" your new job by now, and do you still feel as enthusiastic about it as you did at the beginning? Of course, any job has its tiresome tasks, but all in all, from what you told us, it sounds like a good match for you. We're writing to ask when we can expect repayment of the $1,500 loan for your car. We were glad to help you with the purchase of your car so that you'd have transportation back and forth to your new job. You agreed to pay all, or at least half, of the loan by June. If you have decided that you cannot repay the total $1,500 at once, we understand. But we do need to receive at least half that amount within the next 2 or 3 weeks. We hope you are satisfied with the car you chose. We, too, thought it was a good buy. Please let us know how things are going.

Sincerely,
Joseph Brown
Financial Advisor

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하시오.

det.ref:
[원문] You agreed to pay all
[해석] 당신은 전액을 지불하기로 동의했다
det.correct: to pay: agree + to V(to부정사를 목적어로 취하는 동사)
det.tip: agree + to V: ~하기로 동의하다

questions.passage:
Dear Mr. Johnson,

Have you "settled into" your new job by now, and do you still feel as enthusiastic about it as you did at the beginning? Of course, any job has its tiresome tasks, but all in all, from what you told us, it sounds like a good match for you. We're writing to ask when we can expect repayment of the $1,500 loan for your car. We were glad to help you with the purchase of your car so that you'd have transportation back and forth to your new job. You agreed to pay all, or at least half, of the loan by June. If you have decided that you cannot repay the total $1,500 at once, we understand. But we do need __________ (receive) at least half that amount within the next 2 or 3 weeks.

Sincerely,
Joseph Brown
Financial Advisor
